questions.question: When parking your vehicle on a hill, what should you do?

options.text: Touch one of your rear wheels to the curb.
Use your parking brake and put the vehicle in "park."
Point your front wheels parallel to the road if there is no curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your parking brake and put the vehicle in "park."
questions.explanation: When parking on a hill, always use your parking brake and put the vehicle in "park." If there is no curb, turn your front wheels so the car will roll away from traffic if the brakes fail. If there is a curb, turn your wheels toward it when heading downhill, or away from it when heading uphill.

questions.question: What does a flashing red light mean?

options.text: You are driving the wrong way.
Stop completely, just like at a stop sign.
You cannot go until the light turns green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, just like at a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Come to a complete stop at the stop line. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. Yield to all other traffic and pedestrians before proceeding.

questions.question: If your tires lose contact with the road surface, what should you do?

options.text: Slow down by shifting to a lower gear.
Slow down by pumping the brakes hard and fast.

questions.explanation: If your tires lose contact with the road, slowly release the gas pedal. Do not brake or turn until your tires grip the road again.

questions.question: When driving past a car that just parked on the side of the road, what should you do?

options.text: Expect the driver to open the car door.
Assume the driver will wait for you to pass before opening the door.

questions.correctAnswerText: Expect the driver to open the car door.
questions.explanation: When passing a parked car, be prepared for the driver to open the door. Drive slowly and carefully near parked vehicles.

questions.question: Railroad crossings should always be treated as:

options.text: Places where you must always stop.

questions.explanation: Railroad crossings are always dangerous. Look and listen for trains from both directions. Follow all signs, signals, and flaggers. Only cross when you are sure it is safe.

questions.question: Regulatory signs are usually what color and must always be obeyed?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are usually white with black markings. They control traffic and must always be obeyed.

questions.question: A fire engine is following you on a two-lane street without using its emergency lights or siren. What should you do?

options.text: Stop as fast as you can.
Speed up to get out of the way.
Slow down, move right, and stop.

questions.explanation: If an emergency vehicle is following you without lights or sirens, it is not responding to an emergency. Drive normally and do not change your behavior.

questions.question: When can you cross double solid yellow lines?
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean you cannot pass or change lanes. You can only cross them to turn left into or from a driveway, or to make a U-turn where allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign warns you that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: When a school bus is picking up or dropping off children, you must:

options.text: Stop, no matter which direction you are driving.
Stop only if you are driving the same direction.
Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, no matter which direction you are driving.
questions.explanation: When a school bus is picking up or dropping off children, you must stop completely before reaching the bus, regardless of which direction you are driving.

questions.question: When you park uphill on a street with a curb, what should you do?

options.text: Keep the front wheel straight and set the parking brake.
Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
Turn the front wheels toward the curb.
Turn the back wheels into the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
questions.explanation: Turn your wheels away from the curb when parking uphill. If your brakes fail, your car will roll toward the curb instead of into traffic.

questions.question: What should you do when driving in bad weather?
questions.explanation: In bad weather, steer and brake slowly and gently. Avoid sudden stops or sharp turns, as these make your car harder to control.

questions.question: What is a "No zone"?

options.text: The blind spot of a large vehicle
An area designated for motor vehicles

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spot of a large vehicle
questions.explanation: A "No zone" is a blind spot around a large truck or vehicle. Stay out of these areas because the driver cannot see you.

questions.question: What do pennant-shaped signs mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs mark no passing zones. The sign will have text that says "No Passing" to confirm this.

questions.question: If you have a sudden tire blowout, what should you do?
questions.explanation: If a tire blows out, hold the steering wheel firmly and keep the car going straight. Slow down gradually by releasing the gas and using gentle braking.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
You will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
You should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of an upcoming railroad crossing. Look and listen for trains, slow down, and be ready to stop. Cross only when you are sure no trains are coming.

questions.question: When is highway pavement most slippery?

options.text: If it has been raining several hours.
If it has just begun to rain.
If it has been raining for one to two hours.

questions.correctAnswerText: If it has just begun to rain.
questions.explanation: Pavement is most slippery when rain first starts. Rain mixes with dirt and oil on the road, creating a slick surface.

questions.question: What should you try first if your headlights fail?

options.text: Turn the headlight switch on and off.

questions.explanation: If your headlights fail, first try the dimmer switch. This often turns them back on.

questions.question: What does a single broken white line down the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers can pass when safe.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. A broken line means you can pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What is the first thing you should adjust when you get into a car to drive?
questions.explanation: Adjust your seat first. This ensures you can see clearly and reach the pedals comfortably. Then adjust your mirrors and steering wheel.

questions.question: When changing lanes to the left, where should you look to check your blind spot?
questions.explanation: To check your blind spot, look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move.

questions.question: When can you legally turn left at a red light after stopping?

options.text: You are on a two-way street turning onto a two-way street.
You are on a one-way street turning onto another one-way street.
You yield to all other traffic at the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are on a one-way street turning onto another one-way street.
questions.explanation: After a complete stop, you can turn left at a red light only if you are on a one-way street turning onto another one-way street. No signs can prohibit this turn.

questions.question: How far should you sit from the steering wheel?
questions.explanation: If your car has an airbag, sit at least 12 to 15 inches from the steering wheel. Do not move your seat so far forward that you cannot steer properly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal driving speed for that area. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit. When conditions are poor, drive more slowly.

questions.question: When turning left onto a one-way street, which lane should you turn into?

options.text: The lane closest to your previous lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to your previous lane.
questions.explanation: Always turn from the lane closest to the direction you want to go. Turn into the lane closest to your previous lane.

questions.question: What color are regulatory signs?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers about laws they must follow. These signs can cover traffic direction, lane use, turning, speed, parking, or special situations. They are usually white squares or rectangles with black, red, or green letters or symbols.

questions.question: What should you do at a flashing red light?

options.text: Slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.
Turn right or left since the road ahead is blocked.
Stop and wait for a flashing green light.
Stop, then proceed when the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, then proceed when the way is clear.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must come to a full stop. Then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What are signs called that require drivers to obey an instruction?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs require drivers to obey an instruction. Breaking this rule can result in a penalty.

questions.question: What lights should you use when driving in fog?

options.text: It does not matter which lights you use.

questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when driving in fog, rain, or snow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and roads where you cannot enter. You may see this sign if you try to enter an expressway ramp going the wrong direction.
